title: TAP SBOM supplemental manifest
description: Declared out-of-band components of a published image (req-cicd-sbom-3): everything entering the image outside a package manager. One manifest per image, beside its Dockerfile; loader-validated against this schema; merged into the generated CycloneDX + SPDX during the single derivation. File hashes are computed from the scanned artifact at generation time, never declared here.

_description.description: Human/AI-readable purpose of this manifest instance.

format.description: Manifest format discriminator; bump on breaking shape changes.

_description.description: Why this component exists and how it enters the image.

name.description: Component name as it appears in the SBOM (and in the req-cicd-sbom-7 canary list).

version.description: Exact version; for copied binaries this must match the Dockerfile pin.

source.description: Provenance: pinned source URL (self-built) or upstream image ref incl. digest (copied-image).

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the image; generation hashes THIS file per-arch.
